heading: Systems Architecture & Engineering Decisions
intro: Architectural mechanisms, trade-offs, and design decisions applied across quantitative research, trading systems, real-time market data, and cloud infrastructure.

systems_architecture.problem: Trading research depended on reliable historical datasets across multiple financial data types, making data consistency and validation essential before analysis.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Built pipelines to download, verify, clean, and process tick, quote, fundamentals, EOD, minute, ETF, and daily market data.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Added dedicated validation and reporting stages to improve data quality before it reached downstream research and strategy workflows.
systems_architecture.result: Created reusable data pipelines with automated verification reports for accuracy and consistency.

systems_architecture.problem: Strategy development needed to work across both live trading and historical analysis without maintaining completely separate workflows.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Developed trading strategies and supporting pipelines for live and backtesting environments, alongside Python-based analysis, visualization, and market-scanning tools.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Required common data and strategy workflows across different execution environments in exchange for a more consistent research-to-production process.
systems_architecture.result: Supported strategy development across live trading, backtesting, market analysis, and scanning workflows.

systems_architecture.problem: Financial data workloads created significant memory overhead when large datasets were processed through conventional managed-memory structures.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Engineered memory-mapped files and blittable structs to handle financial data more efficiently while reducing managed-memory overhead.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Introduced more explicit memory and data-layout handling in exchange for substantially lower resource consumption.
systems_architecture.result: ~80% reduction in memory usage across the system.

systems_architecture.problem: Performance-sensitive quantitative components needed efficient execution while the broader trading platform remained flexible within the .NET ecosystem.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Integrated unmanaged C++ components with C#/.NET trading infrastructure to support performance-critical workloads.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Added complexity at the managed and unmanaged boundary in exchange for greater control over performance-critical components.
systems_architecture.result: Combined C#/.NET strategy architecture with native C++ performance capabilities.

systems_architecture.problem: Real-time tick and quote data needed to reach a large client base with minimal delivery delay.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Built a low-level socket-based streaming architecture for real-time stock market tick and quote distribution.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Required lower-level network programming and explicit data-flow handling in exchange for tighter control over the streaming path.
systems_architecture.result: Delivered real-time market data to hundreds of clients with <10ms delay.

systems_architecture.problem: Trading infrastructure required a more dynamic cloud approach to improve operational efficiency and support migration.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Developed and deployed a dynamic system for cloud-based trading migration adapted to operational requirements.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Introduced additional migration and deployment orchestration in exchange for substantially lower infrastructure costs.
systems_architecture.result: Reduced operational costs by 98.8% while improving support efficiency.
